nodes.title: How to use this workflow
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 per-row video inpainting

1. Upload a **24 fps** source video containing an audio track.
2. Upload or paint a mask image. **White regenerates; black preserves.** One mask image is broadcast across the full video.
3. Edit the H3 prompt to describe the intended replacement inside the mask.
4. Queue the workflow.

The **Trim Source AV** node drops trailing frames to the largest valid `17k+5` length and trims audio to the same 24 fps duration. Its `h3_length` output controls H3 conditioning.

The resized source frames feed all three spatial branches: video VAE encoding, the 32×32 grid preview, and any optional tracking. Replace the static Load Image mask connection with **SAM3 Track to Mask** for a moving temporal mask.

The source video is the main latent and must not also be connected as an H3 reference video. Use the MiniMax H3 video VAE for frames and the MiniMax H3 audio VAE for audio.

subject_definitions:

{doc_brown} Wardrobe: his established referenced outfit and appearance.

summary:

[reference generation] The target video shows {doc_brown} urgently reacting to his situation. {doc_brown} delivers a single line before continuing his frantic physical reaction.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1: 0s] Medium shot of only {doc_brown}. He looks around urgently, visibly alarmed and trying to determine what to do next. No dialogue.

[Shot 2: 1.5s] The camera makes a quick subtle push toward {doc_brown}. His eyes widen as he suddenly throws his hands outward and says with frantic urgency, <d>[English]I need to get back to 1985!</d>

[Shot 3: 4.5s] {doc_brown} completely finishes speaking. He hurriedly turns, looks around for a way out, and begins moving with frantic determination. The camera loosely tracks his movement.

[Shot 4: 7.2s] {doc_brown} abruptly stops and looks off-camera as though he has spotted what he needs. He points toward it, then quickly rushes out of frame.

[Shot 5: 9.2s] The camera holds briefly on the now-empty space where {doc_brown} had been standing. No dialogue.

{doc_brown} is the only speaking character. His dialogue is spoken in the established voice of §doc_brown§. No other voices or dialogue are audible.

overall_soundscape:

Natural environmental ambience underneath {doc_brown}'s voice, with subtle movement and clothing sounds as he turns and rushes away.

non_diegetic_music:

A brief tense, energetic cinematic orchestral underscore builds beneath the scene and rises slightly as {doc_brown} rushes out of frame.
